visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a light blue crop top and white loose-fitting pants, stands in a bright room with glass ceilings and walls. She fixes her hair and checks her appearance. Behind her, a wooden cat tree and cactus-shaped cat scratching post are visible on a wooden floor. (2) Close-up shot of the woman applying a pink lip tint with a wand. She looks directly into the lens, using it as a mirror, with natural sunlight illuminating her face. (3) She uses a pink object to fix her hair at the top, then adjusts the long strands over her shoulders, looking satisfied. (4) The camera focuses on her hand as she holds up a small gold earring, then she carefully inserts it into her left ear while looking off-camera. (5) She stands in the same room, checking her full-length reflection, turning side-to-side with her hands in her pockets to evaluate her outfit. (6) The woman uses a cordless vacuum cleaner to sweep the wooden floor in the sunlit living space, moving methodically. (7) She picks up and unrolls a large brown yoga mat on the floor near the large windows. (8) She performs yoga, starting in a downward dog position, then transitions into a full headstand (Sirsasana) with her legs straight up towards the glass ceiling. (9) She carefully lowers her legs and rests in a child's pose on the mat, concluding the physical activity in the quiet, bright room.
